chapter_summary: Manye Zhe, a killer, encounters Ji Chenxi (Bai Wei) holding a white rose, which contradicts his expectation of Bai Wei being an omega. Ji Chenxi, who was just kissed by Chi Zhuo, clarifies his identity and intentions to Manye Zhe. They discuss their online friend Que Qi and the dangers they face. Later, Ji Chenxi, Manye Zhe, and Que Qi (Lu Churan) meet and discuss the auction material, which is about a 'miracle' and is half true, half fabricated. They anticipate attracting powerful factions to the auction.
